title: loadng discovery: RREQ hop_limit>4 → negative actual_hops → ValueError crash (remote DoS)
description: discovery.py:115 assumes origin flooded at INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT=4; wire accepts 0..15 (messages.py). hop_limit=5..15 gives actual_hops<0; RouteEntry.__post_init__ (cache.py:53) raises uncaught ValueError inside process_rreq. Spec-legal input kills routing loop. Fix: reject/clamp hop_limit>INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT as malformed; regression test at boundary.
